name: unsafe fn drop_in_place (self)
rule: While `NonNull::drop_in_place` is executing, parts of the value pointed to by `self` may only be accessed through the `&mut self` references supplied to the `Drop::drop` methods it invokes.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { unsafe fn drop_in_place (self) }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL, which cannot observe accesses during execution or identify the references used for those accesses.
